scope:
Audit common mechanical-port normalization without per-note retuning.

Screen every key at two velocities, compare the previously known references,
check long holds, measure native cost, then render two complete MIDI pieces.
Parallel screening timings are not performance measurements.
status: Common physical-model correction; listening comparison pending
baseline: Accepted treble residual, local C4 tuning removed (0b7cf7f5)
physical_change: Normalize the rank-one mechanical port by its own active-string norm; mask absent strings; retain quiet coupled coordinates

summary.note: Changes in all 88 keys are screened. Only the twelve known reference pairs have a reference comparison; not blind validation.

timing.scope: 14-second native script; three sequential runs each, alternating order, includes raw I/O

limitations: Internal norm contraction is not SI energy or proof of perceptual improvement. No manual note-specific retuning. Known references cover twelve cases, not the entire keyboard.
